how_to_read: My review of the judge: every grade I would change, after reading every answer it marked wrong or partly and 16 it marked right (all 16 right). The scores use these grades; SCORES.md also gives the judge's own count.

broken-01.why: Gives $75.00 and $10.00 a day; the $175.00 cap is detail in parentheses, not required.

short-11.why: Says the lease does not mention renter's insurance; 'so it does not require it' is a fair inference, not a claim that the lease says so.

long-07.why: Gives the $40.00 per bedroom allowance and says use above it is billed to the tenant; the equal split is detail in parentheses.

sample-11.why: 'Not without the landlord's prior written consent' is the point; the judge missed it.

short-11.why: Same as B: says the lease does not mention it.

sample-10.why: Right conclusion (needs written consent) but rests on the subletting clause, not the 14-day guest limit.

long-02.why: Says a cat needs written approval under the Animal Addendum, but misses that the unit is pet-friendly and the fees.
